# Original-game regression fixtures

Ten already archived games selected by full PGN SHA-256 from the player packages. Kept byte-for-byte (apart from inter-game blank lines) to test exact identity, legal replay, FEN clocks and SAN. Lichess Broadcast games retain original broadcast URLs and attribution and are used under CC BY-SA 4.0. The Hou–Tan league game retains its original archival headers; inclusion does not assert a new blanket license over source games.

These small regression fixtures are not a new collection or data-release entry point. Production validation reads the rebuilt player archives, never these fixtures.
